content.text:
**No — not in this session.** You're running the `work` profile (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.config/claude-work`), which filters the classifier hook out.

| Profile | Local classifier |
|---|---|
| personal | enabled |
| work | **disabled** |
| zai | enabled |
| `~/.claude` (mirrors work) | **disabled** |

Wired at `home.nix:810-823` — `work` drops `localAutoModeHook` from `PreToolUse`; commit `b2f1312` did it.

Note: `permissions.defaultMode` is still `"auto"` in work — auto mode itself is on, just the *local* classifier is gone, so classification falls back to the server-side path.

Next: run `claude-prof run personal` if you want the local classifier for a given session.
